title: Barnaby II, ten
logline: The pup at ten, on the beach, gray at the muzzle, lying in the sun at the drift log. A page of the dog, like October 2003's four panels, in one.

panels.composition: The drift log in June sun and, in its lee, the three-legged dog at ten: gray muzzle, the one hind leg tucked, eyes half shut, the whole animal at rest in a few sure lines. The sand, the log, the dog, the light. Nothing asked of any of it.

characters.pose: at rest in the log's lee

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a bleached drift log on a sunny beach with an old gray-muzzled three-legged dog lying at rest in its lee with eyes half closed, drawn in a few sure lines, sand and light, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The pup at ten. The 2003 dog page, once more.
